messages.subject: Re: Jake Essex for Ye Olde Monken Holt?
messages.body:
Hi,

Quick bump on Jake Essex for Ye Olde Monken Holt. He's a proper 50s and 60s singer from Essex (himself, not a tribute), own PA, no deposit.

Fee is from £250 for two one hour sets. Saturday nights this year and into 2027. If a date works, just reply here and I'll lock it in.

Natalie
